title: Concept: Verdaccio console is reachable without authentication
description: A private npm registry is a supply-chain entry point: anonymous publish lets the caller place a package version that CI resolves by name. The interface also lists every private package name and its maintainers.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller enumerates private package names and, with open publish, ships a version that the build pipeline will install.
